svg.title: Production placement
svg.desc: Deployment. Edge contains Global CDN with 2 replicas: storefront 2026.09.1. Production / eu-west-1 contains API pods with 3 replicas: api v2.4.1, otel sidecar 0.109.0; RDS primary with 1 replica: postgres 16.4. Networks: Global CDN to API pods over HTTPS:443, cross-zone. API pods to RDS primary over TLS:5432, internal, asynchronous.
